facts.text: Drink slowly, eat what the sietch shares, and stay close to the fire tonight.
facts.why: Stilgar never says this. His real lines are about the Lisan al-Gaib and 'As written!'. A notice from Stilgar fits the plot, so it can stay as a note with no quote marks.
